drhp.business: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited (Chola) is a diversified NBFC serving primarily the commercial vehicle and transport ecosystem, alongside small and medium enterprises, homeowners, and consumers. It provides vehicle finance, loan against property, home loans, SME loans, consumer and small enterprise loans, and secured business and personal loans, underpinned by prudent underwriting and a diversified funding base.

drhp.expansion: The Company directed capital expenditure of ₹27.02 crores (11.38% of total capex) in FY 2025-26 towards digital and energy efficiency categories. This included investments in electric mobility, digital and software assets, energy efficient smart air conditioning, LED lighting and monitors, RFID enabled devices, safety signage, and UPS infrastructure. sk.overview: India's digital financial services and NBFC-led retail lending sector serves a large, young, credit-underpenetrated mass market. Formalization (GST, JAM/India Stack, eKYC), rising smartphone/internet penetration and low data costs are enabling tech-led NBFCs and fintechs to underwrite and serve borrowers that conventional banks have historically underserved, particularly in unsecured personal loans and loan-against-property.
